name: Lerone Murphy

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (69 in height, 73 in reach, orthodox, featherweight). Weighed 145 lb for UFC London on 2026-03-20 (UFC official weigh-in results); lost to Movsar Evloev by majority decision on 2026-03-21, his first UFC loss (Al Jazeera caption). Nickname 'The Miracle' comes from surviving being shot in the face and neck in Manchester in 2013 (Manchester Evening News reporting, via search); only marks visible in the photos are described below.

photo_coverage: Good for the face and body, but no free-licence photos exist: Wikimedia Commons has no file of him (searched 'Lerone Murphy'), so all 10 photos are reference-only. Front: ESPN studio headshot and a high-res Aug 2025 weigh-in. Three-quarter: March 2026 media day and a high-res Aug 2025 presser. Profile: March 2026 face-off (left side, close). Physique: two ESPN cutouts, UFC 319 ceremonial flex, March 2026 post-fight. Action: March 2026 vs Evloev.

face.shape: Long, narrow oval: high forehead, high cheekbones, flat cheeks and a narrow lower face tapering to a small chin. Very lean, almost gaunt at fight weight.
face.jaw: Narrow and lightly defined, angling in toward the chin.
face.chin: Small and slightly recessed behind the lips in profile; extended visually by the goatee.
face.cheekbones: High and prominent, with hollows under them.
face.forehead: High, broad and smooth, slightly sloping back in profile.

eyes.shape: Almond, slightly hooded upper lids, outer corners level; calm, half-lidded look in most photos.

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low, slightly thicker at the inner ends, tapering at the outer ends.

nose.width: Broad at the base with wide, slightly flared nostrils; bridge medium-narrow between the eyes.

face.mouth_lips: Full lips, lower lip fuller than the upper; medium-wide mouth. In profile the lips sit forward of the chin. Resting expression neutral, lips closed.

ears.cauliflower_ear: No: normal folds in the headshot and the March 2026 profile.

face.notable_marks_scars: A short diagonal scar line on his left cheek beside the nose (sharpest in the Aug 2025 weigh-in photo) and several small darker marks on the right cheek (ESPN headshot, March 2026 media day). The cut on the forehead in the March 2026 post-fight photo is fresh fight damage, not permanent.

hair.style: Short tight curls on top (about 3-4 cm) with a low skin fade on the sides and back and a crisp lined-up front; same cut in 2025 and March 2026.
hair.hairline: Lined up straight across the forehead with squared corners at the temples; no recession.

facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin; the moustache is thinner and close-trimmed; cheeks clean.
facial_hair.shape: A thin moustache, a soul patch and a dense rounded chin goatee about 1.5-2 cm long, extending slightly under the chin; jawline and cheeks shaved. Consistent from 2025 through March 2026.

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on lit skin (box in source pixels). The ESPN headshot is graded warm and saturated, so its face samples run orange and light; the same studio's full-body cutout reads darker (#a25d3e, #8d543e), as do the March 2026 media-day samples. tone_hex is the plain average without the flash hotspot; tone_hex_recommended (#af6a48) drops the three saturated headshot samples and is the better target for a render.
skin.undertone: Warm (red-brown); glossy highlights on the forehead, cheekbones and shoulders under stage light.
skin.freckles_marks: Cheek marks as above; light body hair on the forearms and shins.

body.build: Compact but very muscular featherweight: 175 cm with a 185 cm reach (arms clearly long for his height), broad shoulders and a strong V-taper.
body.body_fat_notes: Shredded at weigh-ins: visible abs, serratus and vascular arms; defined even on fight night.
body.shoulders: Broad with big, round capped delts; widest of these four fighters for his size.
body.chest: Thick, well-developed pecs with a clear lower line.
body.arms: Long arms with big biceps and triceps and muscular forearms.
body.legs_calves: Lean, muscular thighs; slim lower legs and moderate calves.
body.posture: Upright and relaxed, shoulders down; stands with the chin slightly raised.
body.notable_physique_traits: Big shoulders and arms on a small frame, long reach, left-shoulder clock tattoo and chest script, small rounded goatee.

tattoos.where: Left chest (upper pec, toward the shoulder)
tattoos.description: Black cursive script in several lines, roughly 'Through every dark night there's a brighter day / God will never put you through anything you can't handle' (partly legible), with clouds and sun rays and a small bird above it.
tattoos.size: About 18 cm wide x 12 cm tall

tattoos.description: Black-and-grey pocket-watch or clock face with Roman numerals surrounded by roses and shading, wrapping the deltoid.

tattoos.where: Lower left abdomen, beside the navel
tattoos.description: Realistic black-and-grey portrait of a lion cub's face.
tattoos.size: About 10 cm wide x 8 cm tall

tattoos.description: Memorial-style black-and-grey portrait of a person under a sunburst, with script and what looks like a year range ending in 2016 below (not fully legible).
Black script lettering running along the forearm (not legible) plus a small mark near the elbow.

accessories_seen: Black sunglasses at the UFC 319 ceremonial weigh-in; a light-green wristband there.

kit.typical_shorts: Red UFC shorts, compression-length in the studio cutouts (red with white and maroon slash marks, black UFC waistband panel); March 2026 fight night: red shorts with 'MURPHY' down the right leg and a black UFC waistband, blue corner tape on black UFC gloves.
kit.brand_note: Logos visible: UFC, crypto.com (newer cutout), Venum (older cutout).

stance_and_guard.seen_in_photos: March 2026 vs Evloev: bending low at the waist to slip, hands dropped near the hips, head well off the centre line. Only one action frame, so this is a moment, not his habitual guard.

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-middleage_african_male (closest swatch, #875d4b; slightly darker and cooler than his sampled tone, so warm it a little toward #af6a48)
render_hints.hair: short tight curls about 3.5 cm on top, low skin fade, crisp line-up; colour #221817
render_hints.beard: goatee and moustache: thin moustache, dense rounded chin goatee about 15 mm, cheeks and jaw clean, #181112

morphs_extra._note: Targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (read by src/avatar3d.js). Ears are ordinary and close to the head; the cues are full lips over a small chin and hollow cheeks. The face sheet sets lip volume up on purpose: avatar3d's athleteTargets thins every male lip, which would lose his full lips.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, skin, tattoos and build; medium-high for the face (two sharp fronts, two three-quarters, one close profile); medium for morph values. No embed-ok photos exist (nothing on Commons). What to watch: (1) long narrow oval face with high cheekbones and hollow cheeks; (2) short tight curls with a low fade and a crisp straight line-up; (3) broad nose base with wide nostrils; (4) full lips sitting forward of a small chin, framed by a dense rounded goatee and thin moustache; (5) very muscular upper body for 175 cm, long arms (185 cm reach), big capped delts; (6) left-chest script, left-shoulder clock with roses, lion-cub portrait low on the left abdomen, forearm pieces; (7) medium-deep warm brown skin, use tone_hex_recommended. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65 like src/avatar3d.js.
